identity.canonicalName: ACCReS｜文化与情境考量｜教师自评｜美国英文35题版分区
identity.instrumentFamily: ACCReS / 2019 downloadable instrument / 2024 scoring guide / en-US / teacher self-report

construct.constructDefinition: Consideration of Culture and Context；原35题ACCReS第14–24题，共11题。教师对实践、理解或支持获取的自陈；不等同已观察的教学质量。仅来源目录候选；内部原生无分表单已另行准备，公开题文再分发范围尚未确认。

population.populationNotes: 原研究为美国K–12教师样本，非学生自评；无官方成人年龄上下界。语言/制度/文化情境不自动等同中国；不宣称已验证中文版。

administration.timeFrame: 未新增回忆窗口；按原题本关于日常教学行为与想法的指导语。
layoutConstraints: 保留原英文题文、六档同意选项及35题母工具原顺序；原指导语和文化定义必须随原组卷保留。
分区是内容组织；拆分独立施测不是已验证短版。
预计时间为编辑估计，未实测。
2024指南以各题群体同意比例作发展讨论；不编造个人维度均分、总分、反向键、缺失插补或常模。

intendedUses.notes: 开发团队初步验证不能证明本项目独立分区版或中国情境等值；待权利范围审核。

localization.translationSource: Development-team downloadable ACCReS Word instrument (2019 footer), cross-checked with the instrument in the 2024-cited PDF guide.
localization.notes: 原英文保留；中文名称和反馈草稿为项目编辑说明，不是经验证的中文版。

source.title: ACCReS Instrument and Scoring Guide; development-team downloadable Word instrument
source.citation: Fallon, L. M., Cathcart, S. C., Johnson, A. H., Minami, T., O’Keeffe, B. V., & Sugai, G. (2019). Assessment of Culturally and Contextually Relevant Supports (ACCReS). Unpublished instrument, University of Massachusetts Boston. The guide recommends the same authors (2024). Development paper: Fallon et al. (2023), Assessment for Effective Intervention, 48(2), 100–112. https://doi.org/10.1177/15345084221111338

limitations: 35-item original form context; not independently validated as a standalone short form.
The guide specifies group response percentages and within-section item prioritization, not teacher rankings.
The 2023 paper uses 0–5 response codes; the downloadable instrument and 2024 guide display 1–6. No silent coding conversion or raw-score formula is implemented.
No individual scoring formula, reverse key or missing-response policy was established from the retrieved guide. No executable scale, score report, norms, cutoffs or cross-tool total.
Teacher self-report feedback describes perceived practices, understanding and access to support. It does not demonstrate actual teaching quality or label an educator.
reportPlan.disclaimer: 仅目录候选，不可施测。内部FORM只保存原始类别，无评分参数或分数报告；示例文案是面向教师本人的发展性说明，沿既有接收者授权。

blockers: Public download does not establish redistribution, commercial platform, derivative translation or external digital administration rights; scope remains unconfirmed.
Native no-score forms are private isolated DRAFT preparation, not installed in the public development library or production.
Individual scalar scoring instructions remain unresolved; group item-percentage guidance must not be substituted with individual means.
Production database/admin-created instrument deduplication is not performed.
